name: Ail na Mírenn
text: Ail na Mírenn, sometimes written Aill na Mureann, points to Uisnech. Uisnech stands as the sacred center of Ireland. There the provinces met at the stone of divisions. Ail na Mírenn literally names that stone.

attributes.attribute: another name for Uisnech, the stone of divisions
the sacred center of Ireland where the provinces met

okr.objective: Connect Ail na Mírenn to Uisnech, the sacred center of Ireland.
key_results: Recognize Ail na Mírenn as another name for Uisnech.
Translate the term as the stone of divisions.
Place the site at the meeting point of the provinces.
